transcription.text: A. Listen, then point and say...
I live in a new flat.
There are many cars in the street.
There are many trees around it.
There are some sheep on the farm.
People live in all kinds of homes.
Some live in flats and some live in houses.
Some homes are big and some are small.
Some homes are in cities and some are in the country.
There are a lot of people, streets and big buildings in cities.
In the country, there are farms.
I live on a farm in the country.
Jenna's house is in the country.
Billy's house is in a city.
Look at all the cars and buses in the streets.
There are a lot of people and tall buildings.
Now I'm in a nice place.
There's a school and some buildings here.
You can see a park here too.
My last stop is a farm.
You can see small houses and fruit trees.
City mouse lives in a city.
There are too many people and cars here.
Let me visit my friend in the country.
City mouse goes to visit his friend country mouse.
In the country they eat apples for dinner.
It's quiet here but it's not fun.
Come with me to the city.
In the city they eat some nice food.
Come with me to the country.
The country is good for you but the city is good for me.
They go back to their homes.
